name: Philipp Gutheim
headline: Supply Chain Executive and Board Member | ex-Google
location: San Francisco Bay, United States of America
summary:
I’m the founder & CEO of Glacis. We help supply chain teams get more visibility, control and efficiency in their processes to reduce costs and increase service quality. We do that by eliminating manual communication with service providers, coordination with suppliers, rekeying of documents, and cross-system handoffs between ERPs, TMSs - so that teams close loops faster, exceptions resolve automatically, and leaders operate on clean, real-time data.

I started in supply chain 10 years ago when co-founding an ocean visibility provider (Terminal 49), by working out of the office of a drayage trucking company at the port for 2 years. Prior to that, I ran strategy for a $2.5B advertiser segment at Google and and co-founded LeadGenius.

I’m a Y Combinator alum and a former Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree. I hold two master’s degrees (Computer Science; Information Management) from UC Berkeley and a bachelor’s in business.

What I’m focused on now
- Shipping reliable agent workflows that do real work (not demos)
- Measurable ops impact (cycle time, touch reduction, on-time delivery)
- Seamless change management for busy logistics teams
- If you lead transportation or supply chain execution and want to remove manual work—or pilot agentic automation—message me and let’s compare notes.

company.name: Glacis
company.tagline: Supply chain AI platform automating enterprise order management, procurement, and transportation to manage by exception
company.description:
Glacis is an AI-powered, end-to-end supply chain execution platform that closes the gap left by ERPs, TMSs, and control towers: the day-to-day coordination still happens in emails, calls, and spreadsheets slow and error-prone. 

Glacis deploys enterprise-ready AI agents to automate this coordination, handle exceptions early, and keep partners on track across order intake, procurement, logistics, fulfilment.
